about: Each provider's current official icon release, and the facts drawio-core-generation/references/providers.md states about it, tied to a marker on its official page. The weekly watch-diagram-sources workflow checks every marker; a missing marker means the provider published a new icon set, renamed a product or moved the page, so providers.md and the icon catalog must be re-verified. raw: true searches the page's HTML, because download file names appear only in links.
